name: Balsamorhiza sagittata
desc: Balsamorhiza sagittata (Wyethia sagittata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Balsamorhiza sagittata is a North American species of flowering plant in the tribe Heliantheae of the family Asteraceae known by the common name arrowleaf balsamroot.
